course.title: Transport Phenomena in Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Deduce Bernoulli's equation. Through a refinery, fuel ethanol is flowing in a pipe at a (18) velocity of 1m/s and a pressure of 101,300 Pà. The refinery needs the ethanol to be at a pressure of 202,600 Pa on a lower level. How far must the pipe drop in height in order to achieve this pressure? Assume that, the velocity does not change. (The density of ethanol is 789 $\mathbf { k g } / \mathbf { m } ^ { 3 } )$
